_comment: Matt's test set (D16), from the feasibility study. The model lab replays these trades with today's values. 'gets' lists what each side received. Players use their Sleeper ID (name alongside for reading). A pick already used gives the player chosen under 'became'; the lab can value it as that player or as the same slot in the next draft. matt_now lists the verdicts that count as agreeing with Matt: 'Fair', or 'Slight edge: X', 'Clear win: X', 'Fleece: X'. horizon is each side's situation at the time: win_now, balanced or long_term.

trades.notes: Matt rates the pick above Saquon overall, closer to the Long-Term view. Check pick values and the 2027 class rating.

trades.matt_now_text: Fair, perhaps a slight edge Chris (injuries since, plus who the 2.10 became)
trades.notes: Check the QB age curve and the 2028 1st.

trades.matt_now_text: Mike's side (Hunter's role change and injury; picks may land later than hoped)
trades.notes: Three 1sts plus a high-value player should balance a star; a plain exponent was too strong when the extra pieces are good ones (D6 refinement).

trades.situation: Lee contending; Ross in the middle, trading for the long term
trades.matt_then: Lee wins at Win Now and Balanced, maybe Long-Term too
trades.matt_now_text: Still Lee, despite Herbert's slow start
trades.notes: Biggest miss in the study: JADL prizes a good young QB, and consolidating against low picks should count more.

trades.situation: Alex contending; Ross moving to the future
trades.matt_then: Slight edge Alex (2026 class seen as weak)
trades.notes: The model favoured the pile over the star. Fixes: the D6 refinement, and a negative rating for the 2026 class.

trades.situation: Chris building to contend this year; Neil hard to read
trades.notes: A young Superflex QB beating picks again points to the league QB premium. Neil consistently overrates picks.
The 3rd and 5th were worth almost nothing, so this was Waddle for a 1st likely to land late. Projecting a contender's pick late (D8) comes with the Sleeper link in Phase 3.

trades.situation: Both contending. Lee needed a QB, Alex an RB
trades.matt_now_text: Fair, but Lee picked badly. Without Jacobs's suspension, an edge to Alex
trades.notes: Judging the pick by the player Lee chose is hindsight; the tool shouldn't do that. Try the lab's 'same slot in the next draft' option.

trades.situation: Dave looking to contend; Ross contending
trades.notes: Matt judges this as picks: 2.01 in a 10-team league is the 11th pick, a late 1st on 12-team charts. Try the lab's 'same slot in the next draft' option.

trades.matt_then: Chris, clearly more than fair but not by a lot
trades.notes: An obvious Chris win even for a rebuilding Ross: a 3rd is worth little even long term.
